thread:
maria: Heads-up: p95 for SSE streaming toolcalls jumped sharply after last deploy — baseline ~110ms, now ~410ms. Rolling release is paused. :warning:
perf-bot: Alert: perf/regression/streaming-latency detected. p95 +~270ms vs baseline job 2139988000 -> job 2141112001.
cheng: I merged PR 4396 last night. Two changes of interest: sse_coalesce_window default lowered 12ms -> 2ms, and toolcall path now runs an extra JSON validation pass (serialize->validate->serialize).
aj: Extra serialize/deserialize per chunk will add CPU and allocations, especially with tiny chunks. Any flamegraphs from affected hosts?
dylan: Sampled a few streaming nodes in us-west-2 canary pool. perf top snapshot:
```
json.Marshal        38.7%
kv_cache.lookup     20.4%
stream.flush        14.1%
syscall.write       10.2%
```
Suggests both serde and KV work spiking.
maria: Also seeing eviction_rate on KV nodes spike ~3.5x right after the rollout. My theory: aggressive coalescing -> many more tiny writes and slightly different prefixes -> higher cache-key cardinality -> LRU thrash.
cheng: Makes sense: smaller coalesce window increases chunk frequency and may split prefixes in ways that increase unique cache keys per session. The validation pass just amplifies CPU cost per chunk.
aj: I traced one user flow: sequence lengths now split into many short frames, each frame doing a kv lookup for prefix and small recompute. That pattern causes a thundering-buffer: too many small writes + lookups + evictions.
srebot: rollout-hold created by maria on release/2026-03-18T20:18:00Z — tag: perf-regression
dylan: Quick A/B I ran: toggling sse_coalesce_window back to 12ms via feature flag reduced p95 from 410ms -> ~125ms on the canary shard. Turning off the extra JSON-validation reduced p95 by ~45ms. So coalesce window is the dominant factor.
cheng: Good signal. I'll draft a revert PR for the coalesce default and a separate PR to remove the extra validation.
maria: Immediate mitigations I want now:
- flip coalesce default back to 12ms via flag and pause rollout (dylan)
- remove the extra JSON validation on the toolcall hot path (cheng)
- increase kv cache soft limit by +25% on streaming nodes to reduce eviction churn (aj)
Post the PR numbers here when created. Also open a follow-up to add a perf CI test that exercises tiny-chunk streaming patterns.
dylan: Flag rollback deployed to ~10% and canaries improving. Patch PR 4399. Monitoring is showing p95 revert toward baseline but will wait 15m for stability.
cheng: Revert PR for validation patch is 4400 — tests green, requesting runtime review.
aj: KV cache soft-limit bump PR 4402 queued, will canary after approvals.
maria: After these land, schedule a full bisect over the release window to ensure no other commits contributed. Also add telemetry to record chunk cardinality and per-request kv lookups so we can alert on this pattern in the future.
dylan: I'll add a synthetic perf test that streams 1-2 token chunks with toolcalls into the perf suite.
maria: Leaving rollout paused until p95 stable for 30m across primary regions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
